title: A Alibi for the Portrait
author: Elodie Halloran
blurb: Sable Delacroix, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the statute expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
